notes.subject: לבער
notes.rationale: 'burning/consuming' (ASV/BSB) vs KJV/JPS 'eaten up' (fire or grazing) — the tenth's fate is disputed.

notes.subject: בשלכת
notes.rationale: 'falling/felling' (ASV) vs 'casting leaves' (KJV/JPS) — what happens to the tree when the stump stays.

notes.subject: kabakurun
notes.rationale: מצבת here is the tree's stock/stump, not the usual 'standing stone' sense of the lemma.

notes.subject: מצבת … מצבתה
notes.rationale: The same word brackets the verse — stump of the felled tree, stump of the land — a frame Bambara keeps by repeating kabakurun.

notes.subject: kisɛ senuma
notes.rationale: The verse seals the vision: a remnant survives only as a stump — the holy seed hidden in the felled land.

translation: Kɔrɔ a kɔnɔ du-tan kelen bɛna kɛ yen, o bɛna segin, o bɛna kɛ ⟨fɛn min bɛ tasuma labasara ye⟩ — i n'a fɔ jiri-senba ni kɔnɔtɔrɔ-jiri, ni u bɛ u lahi kɛ, kabakurun bɛ to u kun na: kisɛ senuma de ye a kabakurun ye.

tokens.gloss: ni u bɛ u lahi kɛ
